name: My Blog AI Writer – AI Blog Writer and Content Generator
author: bitnetinfo

sections.description:
My Blog Writer is a powerful, lightweight, and modern writing assistant that integrates directly into your WordPress post editor. It features a stunning sidebar widget (compatible with both the Classic Editor and Block Editor/Gutenberg) that helps you generate high-quality blog posts and copy instantly using your own OpenAI API key.

Key Features

  • Instant Blog Generation: Input your topic and target keywords, choose your tone, and generate an 800+ word draft with one click.
  • Gutenberg AI Toolbar: A sparkle button is injected into the Block Controls toolbar for every text-based block. Select text to run custom commands, write more, improve, summarize, add analogies, or fix grammar.
  • Surgical Replacements: AI rewrites replace only the selected range, keeping your block type, surrounding inline formatting, alignment, and attributes perfectly intact.
  • Local and Secure: Your OpenAI API Key is securely encrypted inside your local database. No external tracking, no forced lockouts, and no telemetry data sent to third-party licensing servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the my-blog-writer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the .zip file directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Tools > AI Blog Settings to securely save your OpenAI API Key.
  4. Open any Post or Page editor to begin generating high-quality content inside the sidebar widget or directly via the Gutenberg block toolbar.
sections.faq:
Is my OpenAI API Key safe?

Yes, absolutely. Your API key is encrypted using industry-standard AES-256-CBC encryption before it is stored in your WordPress database. The key remains entirely local to your server and is only transmitted securely via HTTPS to the official OpenAI API (api.openai.com).

Does this plugin use external servers or track my data?

No. In full compliance with WordPress.org guidelines, this plugin does not phone home, does not contain license verification gates, and does not send telemetry or site information to any third-party servers. All operations run directly on your own WordPress host.

Which OpenAI models are used?

The plugin is configured to use the cost-effective and highly capable gpt-4o-mini model, ensuring fast response times and high-quality, professional outputs.
